## History

Julia Bell attended school alongside [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md). During her time in the classroom, she witnessed local gossip, academic rivalries, and the arrival of a new teacher, Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md). She was also among the classmates who warmly welcomed [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) back when [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returned to school following a period of absence.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P3](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER XV. ## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--julia-bell.md)

Julia is a schoolmate of [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) warmly welcomed Julia into her circle of friends by writing her a poem that declared their friendship.
